name: Nuclear plant safety
value: ZNPP on one line after 8 Nov power cut
summary: Zaporizhzhia relies on a single power line after losing off-site power on 8 Nov; IAEA warns on Ukraine's winter grid
state: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power for the 27th time on 8 Nov when its only remaining external line, Ferosplavna-1, disconnected, and ran on emergency diesel generators until power returned hours later (Anadolu; Reuters via ThePrint). IAEA Director General Grossi told the IAEA Board on 18 Nov that it would be difficult to overstate his concern about Ukraine's grid as winter sets in (ANS, 19 Nov). Searches on 24 Nov found no damage to safety-critical systems, INES level 2 event or radiological release.
for_you: No action is needed in the UK. The IAEA publishes regular updates on Ukraine's nuclear plants, and any radiological concern for travellers would be reflected in FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance.
rubric_hit: Watch: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power on 8 Nov and relies on one line; IAEA reports grid concern
